extracted.name: Easy mint sauce
extracted.description: Ditch your go-to jar of mint sauce and make this fresher-tasting version with zingy capers and lemon zest. It's the perfect partner to roast lamb at Easter
ingredient_lines: 1 small bunch of mint leaves picked and roughly chopped
½ small bunch of parsley roughly chopped
instruction_lines: Put the mint, parsley and capers in the small bowl of a food processor and blitz until finely chopped.
Add the oil, sugar, vinegar and lemon zest and blitz again until smooth. Season to taste and serve.
